notes.title: [Apologies for delayed update] I'm so sorry! Our update was delayed for a long
notes.content:
Due to our decision to rework the skill system in the previous update plan, which led us to incorrectly estimate the workload, in order to give you a better experience, had to postpone the release of the update for a long time, we expect that the next update will be updated on the 8th of May for the beta, and the official version of the update will be released after 1 week of debugging!

This is a major update, it is estimated that the following aspects will be updated
1.Refactor the skill system
2.Remake skills
3.Add pause function
4.Reconstruct the new monster AI system.
5. Optimise attack judgement
6.Optimise protagonist movement and air wall
7.Solve the skill mapping BUG.
8.Solve the skill flashback BUG.
9.Solve skill invalid BUG

We are very sorry to make you wait so long, we expect to work overtime during the holidays to complete the update! Thank you for your patience! Thank you very much for your support! We promise to keep updating the game for 1 year!

notes.title: Next version update plan preview
notes.content:
Next update content preview, expected to be officially launched in mid April
1. A new attribute table has been created, and more attributes can be created in the future
2. Skill system reset in progress
3. The skill indicator has been remade and will no longer be obstructed by objects
4. The parabolic rule has been reset, and various parabolas in the future will no longer look strange
5. The relationship between terrain and skills has been remade, so there won't be any special effects that look very strange anymore
6. Add pause function

tags.feature: 1. A new attribute table has been created, and more attributes can be created in the future

notes.title: Game April update trailer
notes.content:
Game April update trailer
The game is expected to refactor the skill system in April, and a pause function will be added after the system is redrawn. In the future, it will also support the feature of selecting one out of three skill extraction (which can be added in May). At the same time, the new skill system has been optimized, and skill special effects flying out of the map and incorrect skill mapping bugs will be fixed
However, due to the high workload of this update and the need for modifications to the underlying architecture, we have to cancel the weekly fixed updates until the April update is completed. Thank you for your understanding. We are committed to
